mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_execution_history ( execution_id, agent_id, capability_id, configuration_version, route_kind, target, request_hash, status, started_at ) VALUES ( #{executionId}, #{agentId}, #{capabilityId}, #{configurationVersion}, #{routeKind}, #{target}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{startedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_execution_history SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_type = #{errorType}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'STARTED'
